entities.name: Kusunose Kita
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kusunose Kita was one of the first Japanese advocates for women's political rights. Her actions helped realize women's suffrage (briefly) in parts of her home town of Kochi city, where she is still known as "minken baasan".
